name: St James and All Souls, Salford

boundary.description: From the point where the railway crosses Laundry Street, SE along the railway to the Crescent (A6). Then S by Albion Way (A5063) and W along the railway to the point opposite Cyprus Close, then N by a beeline to Eccles New Road and N along West Ashton Street, Montford Street, Olympic Court and by a bee-line N to and W along Broadway past its junction with Blue and by a beeline to Manchester Ship Canal (to meet Manchester Ship Canal near footpath by SIS Live Teleport). Then W by the Manchester Ship Canal to Centenary Way (A576)and N to the roundabout. By a beeline NE to the junction of Eccles New Road and Stott Lane. N by Stott Lane, E by Eccless Old Road, Chasely Road, to its junction with Bolton Road and by a beeline to Broad Street. SE by Broad Steet, Charles Street, Nave Court, Laundry Street to the point it meets the railway.
